chunks: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Isma'il ibn Hammam, from Ali ibn Ja'far, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about the man who kisses the vagina of the woman, he said, 'There is no harm (it is permissible).'

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm / it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a husband to kiss his wife's vagina according to Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes the permissibility of oral intimacy between spouses, reflecting the Shia juristic view that sexual acts are permissible unless explicitly prohibited. This ruling underscores the principle of *al-asl fi al-shahawat al-ibahah* (the default permissibility of desires within marriage), distinguishing it from acts deemed *makruh* or *haram*. It serves as a foundational text for understanding the flexibility and naturalness of marital relations in Shia fiqh.
